# DrawdownCal

> Drawdown and recovery calculator for traders. Compute the exact percentage gain required to recover from a trading loss.

DrawdownCal is a free calculator that helps traders understand the asymmetry of drawdown: the deeper the loss on your capital, the disproportionately larger the gain required to return to the original peak (recovery). The tool offers two input modes:

- **Percent mode**: enter the drawdown percentage directly (e.g. 30%) via slider or keyboard input.
- **Equity mode**: derive the drawdown automatically from initial capital and current capital.

Beyond the recovery result, the app provides a drawdown vs recovery chart, a monthly-profit break-even estimator, side-by-side scenario comparisons, and share actions (image, text, WhatsApp, Telegram). All calculations run locally in the browser; no data is sent to any server.

## Core formula

Recovery % = Drawdown / (100 - Drawdown) x 100

Example: a 50% drawdown requires a 100% recovery. A 20% drawdown only requires a 25% recovery.

## Pages

- [Home / Calculator](https://drawdowncal.alfindigital.com/): Interactive drawdown calculator.
- [About](https://drawdowncal.alfindigital.com/about): Full guide, formula, reference table, tips and FAQ.
- [All drawdown levels](https://drawdowncal.alfindigital.com/drawdown): List of drawdown levels from 5% to 99% with their required recovery.
- Per-level page, e.g. [Drawdown 50%](https://drawdowncal.alfindigital.com/drawdown/50).

## Quick FAQ

- **What is drawdown?** The percentage decline of your capital from its highest point (peak) to its lowest point (trough).
- **Why is recovery larger than drawdown?** Because recovery is computed from the smaller capital base left after the loss.
- **Is any data stored on a server?** No. All calculations run locally in the browser; nothing is transmitted.
